name: Default
shortDescription: Indexer that ingests Ethereum and EVM chain data into PostgreSQL and serves subgraphs over GraphQL, with a bundled IPFS node.

alerts.message: Set ETHEREUM_RPC to NETWORK:URL of your own RPC endpoint (for example mainnet:https://your-provider/key) and redeploy. The network name must match the network in your subgraph manifests. Without a capability list Graph Node assumes an archive node with traces; declare the real ones as NETWORK:CAPABILITIES:URL (for example mainnet:archive:https://your-provider/key).

Deploy subgraphs with graph-cli and the generated DEPLOY_KEY: graph create --node https://<domain>/deploy/node --access-token <DEPLOY_KEY> <name>, then graph deploy --node https://<domain>/deploy/node --deploy-key <DEPLOY_KEY> --ipfs https://<domain>/deploy/ipfs/api/v0 --headers '{"Authorization":"Bearer <DEPLOY_KEY>"}' <name>.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
